8\. A misparsed code review reads as a clean review 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
run takes findings(body) as the whole truth: when _FINDING matches no `<summary>N.
…</summary> block, it prints verdict: no finding open in the Code Review comment (it numbers
none) and exits 0, even if the header counts it just parsed with categories()` say there are
findings. A small change in the bot's markup (a <b> around the number, a different list tag, say)
would turn a review with open findings into a pass, and both the builder's last unit and the
reviewer's sub-agent rely on this verdict.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description `hands hosted-review` exits 0 with "no finding open" whenever the findings regex matches nothing, even when the header counts say findings exist. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/hosted.py[196-220] - src/hands/hosted.py[376-389] ## Recommended Fix Parse the number in each header category label (`(\d+)`) and add them up. If the total is above zero and `findings(body)` returns fewer entries than that (or none), print a 'could not parse the findings' verdict and return a non-zero exit (1, or a new code) rather than 0. Add a test with a body whose header counts findings but whose `` markup the regex does not match. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
